question: The Prarthana Samaj was established in ________ by Dr. Atma Ram Pandurang.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bombay.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Prarthana Samaj was established in** 1867 in Bombay** (now Mumbai), India.
 
• This was founded by** Dr. Atma Ram Pandurang.**
 
• Other reformers related to Prarthana Samaj were **Mahadev Govind Ranade and R. G. Bhandarkar.**
 
• The organization aimed to promote social reform, rational thinking, and religious and social equality.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Fergusson College **was established in **1885 in Pune** (formerly Poona) by the efforts of the Prarthana Samaj and its leaders.
 
• **Mahadev Govind Ranade **(1842–1901) was a prominent social reformer, historian, and judge in 19th-century India.
 
• Justice Mahadev Gobind Ranade** joined Prarthana Samaj** in **1870.**
 
• His works include** "Rise of the Maratha Power"** and **"The Administration of the Marathas," **which provided detailed insights into the Maratha Empire and its administration.
